title: The effect of pupil size on data quality in head-mounted eye trackers
core_idea: Examine whether pupil size changes cause apparent gaze shifts (pupil-size artifact) in head-mounted video-based eye trackers and assess the impact on data quality by systematically varying screen brightness to induce controlled pupil changes, comparing multiple head-mounted devices and a desktop eye tracker.
tldr: This study investigates if and how pupil-size-induced artifacts affect gaze recordings from head-mounted video eye trackers and their effects on accuracy and precision, using controlled brightness manipulations across several devices and a desktop tracker.
